property.description: Add a custom bank name to the brand switcher dropdown

property.name: customBrandPrimary
property.label: Custom Brand Primary Color
property.description: Hex color for custom bank brand (e.g. #0057B8)

property.name: logoStaticResource
property.label: Logo Static Resource Name
property.description: Name of the Static Resource in Salesforce containing the bank logo image (e.g. BofA_Logo). Leave blank to use text fallback.

property.name: logoHeight
property.label: Logo Height (px)
property.description: Height of the logo image in the header banner, in pixels.

property.name: fallbackCreditScore

property.description: Score shown when no Contact record or Credit_Score__c field value is available.
